newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end firmer, await inflation news.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end firmer, await inflation news.

text.p: 1735 GMT - Bonds ended firmer, lifted by Spanish and Italian gains, with traders waiting for news about Portugal's inflation in February after the good CPI result in Spain. *March 97 futures up 12 basis points at 107.50. *Feb 07 cash 98.80 vs 98.65. Yld 6.70 vs 6.81 Weds *Spread vs Spanish 10-yr cash -18 bps vs -16 bps
